The Kenanga Signal on this row reads None stated even though the report's Investment case paragraph opens "We continue to like MBMR for: (i) its strong earnings visibility...". Separately, the report is internally inconsistent on dividend yield: page 1 and the financial tables both show a 9.0% net dividend yield for FY26F/FY27F, while the Investment case paragraph on page 2 says "attractive dividend yield of about 10%". Both figures are quoted as printed; neither has been reconciled.
